website.command: ./mill -w doc.devServer --host=0.0.0.0 --port={bind_port} --base-address={external_https_proxy_url} & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null; ./mill doc.devServerStop' EXIT; wait $pid

website-static.command: set -o pipefail; eval "$(./mill show doc.serveCmd --host=0.0.0.0 --port={bind_port} --base-address={external_https_proxy_url} | jq -r .)"
